div.head: Ger 7[a]
div.ab: [7[a]] Ne læte he næfre his hyrmen hyne oferwealdan, ac wille he ælcne mid hlafordes creafte 7 mid folcrihte:
Ne læte he næfre his hyrmen hyne of|erwealdan . ac wille he ælcne mid hlafor|des creafte . 7 mid folcrihte .
Ne læte he næfre his hyrmen hyne oferwealdan, ac wille he ælcne mid hlafordes creafte and mid folcrihte:
Nicht lasse er jemals über sich seine [Guts-]unterthanen regieren, sondern er wolle jeden durch Herrenmacht und nach Volksrecht [regieren]:
Let him never let his [estate] dependants rule over him, but let him [rule] each one with the lord's authority and according to folk-right:
He should never let his retainers wield power over him, but he should direct each with the lord’s might and with folk custom.
Nor must he ever permit his subordinates to manipulate him, but he should govern each of them according to his lord’s rule and the laws of the people;
div.note: B's ‘creafte’ stands so. Liebermann's 7 is split here into three rows.
Rabin’s 7 covers the rows 7[a], 7[b], 7[c]; it is given here, in the first.
